withdrawn_expired_duplicate_hypothesis.source_chain: AddAsync prepared version captured before CollectExpired. Every successful expiration removal increments _indexVersion. Any removed entry makes prepared.IndexVersion != current, so EnsureKeysAvailable is skipped; lock exits, ReleaseEntriesAsync always runs, then keys reproject/retry. Duplicate rejection happens only after removed ownership was already released. No AddAsync catch/finally needed for this specific path. The using operation lease exits on failures. A comparer throwing inside removal is a different cause and invalidates this healthy branch, covered only as proposed new case.
withdrawn_expired_duplicate_hypothesis.reviewer_erratum: Initial commentary alert missed version-retry branch; withdrawn immediately after whole-branch/historical check. No new regression case or correction warranted for healthy duplicate expiration.

ranked_new_native_proposals.classification: Strong source-demonstrable invariant-break candidate; no executed native counterexample
ranked_new_native_proposals.cause: Removal drops main _entries member, makes entry inactive, increments _retiringEntries, then calls each index RemoveKey. A once-armed secondary GetHashCode exception occurs after these state changes, before requested is appended to release list or observers/disposal run. RemoveEntry has no transaction/catch or rollback. Public GetAsync returns index value without checking Active. Disposal visits only main _entries, so detached ownership is not recovered by normal disposal.
ranked_new_native_proposals.smallest_original_public_fixture: Theory hostile=false/true. Public ResourceCache<OwnedResource> capacity1 with no expiration during case. Add normal primary string index then secondary string index using stable equality comparer that throws one exact sentinel exception on its first armed GetHashCode and then behaves normally. Commit one resource with comparer unarmed. Arm after successful AddAsync; call primary.RemoveAsync (primary lookup is healthy; secondary comparator first runs in removal). Observe exact sentinel fault only in hostile variant. Disarm in finally before all postreads/teardown. Record primary and secondary GetAsync outcomes and GetValues identities. Require each successful index lookup identity to be present in GetValues; do not prescribe rollback versus completed-removal policy yet. Terminal cache DisposeAsync must release original resource exactly once. On current source hostile variant predicts stale-secondary value with empty GetValues and resource dispose0; healthy variant no stale indexes/dispose1. No sleep, private-field poking or drainer queue.
ranked_new_native_proposals.bounded_cleanup: Capture every started task. Restore comparer, join tasks with independent deadline, finish real cache DisposeAsync before any fallback caller release of leaked resource. Validate expected comparer exception identity; never suppress unexpected faults/timeouts. A capacity-cancel postcontrol may show stranded retiring slot, but is optional and not needed for smallest first proof.
ranked_new_native_proposals.fix_boundary: Choose atomic failed-removal rollback or consistent completed-removal release explicitly after finite original red. A naive catch plus hostile comparer-based rollback can throw again. Preserve observer backpressure/fanout/reentry and resource generation. Mutant should remove exactly the chosen consistency/ownership guard, not trigger arbitrary unrelated errors.

Stronger fixture may make comparer throw only when primary.GetAsync(candidateKey) completes successfully while main GetValues is empty; this public read predicate avoids private reflection and distinguishes commit from precheck, but it must stay finite and be reviewed for read recursion. After disarm: faulted Add candidate must not be retrievable in any published index while absent from GetValues; caller candidate not cache-disposed. Healthy Add exactidentity in both indexes and one cache release.

ranked_new_native_proposals.classification: Resource admission bounded; total concurrent-caller memory bound unspecified
ranked_new_native_proposals.research: No internal notification drainer queue. Awaited SemaphoreSlim can retain caller wait tasks. Caller-supplied resources, projected dictionaries, active operation leases and capacity-wait Tasks can scale with external concurrency although owned committed/pending/retiring resources are bounded. ResourceCacheOptions promises maximum committed/in-flight resources, not unlimited-external-caller allocation immunity. Hard caller admission bound/overflow/cancellation/fairness behavior needs explicit resource contract; do not invent a default cap or drop observations.
ranked_new_native_proposals.smallest_current_contract_control: Capacity1, observer blocks first added callback, finite N (e.g.8) independently canceled caller requests; at most one owned resource/factory, no second factory until retiring removal release. Finally unblock observer, join all callers and disposal, track owned resource exact releases; healthy unblocked control. Assert bounded finite counters and identities, not flaky process RSS or GC thresholds. This can confirm existing bounded ownership; cannot prove arbitrary-concurrency constant memory or mark TODO done.
